plan: A tank support who dashes onto her target, stuns it and starts fights whenever she can.
aSurveiller: Her E (Zenith Blade). She dashes to the last champion hit and roots them, then follows up with her Q, which stuns.
contrer: Stay behind your minions and sidestep when she casts her E.
After her E and her Q, she has no crowd control left: time to fight back.
Spread out in team fights: her R stuns in the centre of the zone.
forces: Lots of stuns in a row.
Her R can start a fight from range.
faiblesses: Easy to avoid if you stay behind minions.
Weak if engaged while her spells are on cooldown.

sorts.P: Her spells mark enemies; her allies deal more damage to them.
sorts.W: More resistances, then damages around her.
sorts.E: Piercing blade; she dashes to the last champion hit.
sorts.R: Solar beam: stuns in the centre, slows at the edges.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 2, and very strong in team fights from level 6.
